title: Joint Editor Fixture
description: The non-code input to a Run: beam centrelines and cross-sections, Role Bindings, and joint constructor parameters.

role_bindings.description: Maps a joint constructor parameter name to an index into `beams`.

params.description: The joint's remaining constructor parameter values. A COMPAS `Data` value is held serialized as {"dtype": ..., "data": ...}; a parameter that cannot be expressed this way is left at its class default and is not settable here.

joint_class.description: The name of the `Joint` subclass this Fixture runs, when the module defines several.
